summary: Complete f to a primitive block matrix [[a, z], [0, v]] (exists_isPrimitiveMatrix_mul_fromBlocks); the columns of (m | y)·f·(that block)⁻¹-pieces are lifts, so m·a and m·z + y·v have integral lifts; the discriminants multiply because m ⊥ y for linkMetric (o) makes the Gram matrix block diagonal and the block matrix has unit generalised determinant.

steps.claim: From the lift data ⟨ρ, _, t, u, p, q, k⟩ of (m | y)·f:
steps.lean:
fun ⟨_, _, t, u, p, q, k⟩ ↦ by
  choose a v z h using exists_isPrimitiveMatrix_mul_fromBlocks _ ⟨_, f.3⟩
  have T {ι} g : HasIntegralLifts (τ := ι) c γ _ := ⟨_, _, t, _, p, ((Matrix.mul_assoc _ u _ ▸ q.mul
    h.1) · <| g ·), congr(submatrix $(Matrix.mul_assoc ..) _ g).symm⟩
  simp [↓k] at T
  use a, v, z, T .inl, T .inr, (isPrimitiveMatrix_iff.1 h).elim fun V ⟨i,
    e⟩ ↦ by simp [linkDiscSq, o, field, by simpa [genIndex_det_eq_one _ _ i,
    IsAdelic.exists_topology] using congr(genIndex (f * $e).det)]

steps.claim: a, v, z with f·[[a, z], [0, v]]⁻¹-type relation: (m | y)·f… = (m·a | m·z + y·v)·(primitive) (h).
steps.lean: choose a v z h using exists_isPrimitiveMatrix_mul_fromBlocks _ ⟨_, f.3⟩

steps.claim: T: restricting the lift data to a subset of the columns (through g : ι → τ ⊕ s) gives lifts of the corresponding columns;
steps.lean:
have T {ι} g : HasIntegralLifts (τ := ι) c γ _ := ⟨_, _, t, _, p, ((Matrix.mul_assoc _ u _ ▸ q.mul
    h.1) · <| g ·), congr(submatrix $(Matrix.mul_assoc ..) _ g).symm⟩

steps.claim: the two lifts are T(inl) and T(inr); and linkDiscSq(m, a)·linkDiscSq(y, v) = linkDiscSq((m | y), f): det((m|y)*LM(m|y)) = det(m*LM m)·det(y*LM y) (o), and [det f] = [det a]·[det v] because the primitive completion has generalised determinant 1 (genIndex_det_eq_one).
steps.lean:
use a, v, z, T .inl, T .inr, (isPrimitiveMatrix_iff.1 h).elim fun V ⟨i,
